module: Shadow quality presets, consumed by graphicsQualityGroup. Each level sets $pref::Shadows::textureScalar and $pref::Shadows::disable. vehicleTexSizes additionally gives the vehicle shadow texture size per level.
notes: The Disabled level sets $pref::Shadows::disable to 2; the other levels to 0.
vehicleTexSizes is not applied by this module: it is a data table read elsewhere (graphic.lua).

qualityLevels.desc: Levels Disabled, Lowest, Low, Normal, High, Ultra. textureScalar: 0.25, 0.25, 0.5, 1.0, 2.0, 4.0.

vehicleTexSizes.desc: Vehicle shadow texture size per level: Disabled 512, Lowest 512, Low 1024, Normal 2048, High 4096, Ultra 8192.
